dimensional-analysis.def: A method of converting units by multiplying by conversion factors arranged so that unwanted units cancel, leaving only the units of the answer. Also called the factor-label method.

conversion-factor.def: A fraction whose top and bottom are equal amounts in different units, such as 1 kWh / 3,412 BTU or 3.79 L / 1 gal, so multiplying by it does not change the amount.

energy-units.def: Units of energy: the joule (J), the kilowatt-hour (kWh, 3.6 million J), the British thermal unit (BTU, about 1,055 J) and the kilocalorie (kcal, about 4,184 J).

power-units.def: The watt (W) is a unit of power: one joule of energy per second. A kilowatt (kW) is 1,000 W and a megawatt (MW) 1,000,000 W. Energy = power × time.
